_comment: Interaction id -> entries. Entries are checked top to bottom: the first entry whose 'requires' flags are all set (and whose 'unless' flags are all unset) plays. Optional on finish: 'set_flags', 'start_fight' (encounter id) with 'win_flags'. A line may set 'portrait' to another asset key, and 'button' to the label of its action button (else the _buttons defaults: 'next' on a middle line, 'close' on the last, 'skip' while typing).

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: What happened to her sister?

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: Have you tried the fireplace? It's lovely this time of year.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: Who sent my letter?

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: The ferry will be back any day now.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: That isn't what I asked.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: Any day now.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: Welcome, welcome! We've all been so excited to meet you.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: All of you? I only got the letter on Tuesday.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: And such a lovely Tuesday it was.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: 'Welcome, Heros.' Well, it's the thought that counts.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: My letter. Same as the day it came.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: That's strange. The ink is still wet.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: It's locked. Why is it humming?

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: There's a page torn out. About eleven years back.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: My name's already in here. I haven't signed anything.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: The ink's wet. Just like my letter.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: My name's already in here. I haven't signed anything.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: Keys for Rooms 2 and 3. Nothing for Room 4.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: It's the coziest room I've ever seen. I don't trust it.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: High score: Agador. I never entered my name.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: One more game.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: Who put this in an inn?

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: Put what, dear?

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: The screen says to insert a coin.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: A key to a room I never booked.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: Turned down, with a mint on the pillow. Very welcoming. Very unsettling.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: The Reserved card is gone. There's a name here now, but the ink's too wet to read.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: Locked. The card says Reserved, but not for whom.

lines.speaker: new_guest
lines.text: She loved these things.

lines.speaker: new_guest
lines.text: She came here. Someone must've seen her.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: The ferry will be back any day now.

lines.speaker: new_guest
lines.text: Why does everyone keep saying that?

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: new_guest
lines.text: Did you get a letter too?

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: On Tuesday. Same as yours?

lines.speaker: new_guest
lines.text: Mine came Tuesday too. So how is it this old?

lines.speaker: new_guest
lines.text: My sister got one just like it. That was eleven years ago.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: And such a lovely Tuesday it was.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: Also reserved. Business must be booming.

lines.speaker: agador
lines.text: Locked, with no key on the board. There's a light on under the door.
